title: Harden filter visual oracles: assert filter pixels render in Ruffle (regression guard for 1238)
description:
DONE (agent-1241). Added apps/desktop/e2e/filter-pixel-oracle.spec.ts: 3 hardened Ruffle PIXEL oracles using the OUTSIDE-BOUNDS DELTA technique (publish filtered SWF + identical no-filter CONTROL SWF, render both in real Ruffle, count lit pixels strictly OUTSIDE the shape bounding box where only a halo/shadow/blurred edge can appear; assert filtered >> control).

Tests: (1) glow adds a yellow halo outside the shape; (2) drop-shadow adds an offset shadow outside the shape with the spill CENTROID biased bottom-right (angle 45deg); (3) blur spreads the edge beyond the crisp control silhouette. Each asserts control ~0 outside, filtered well above noise, and filtered-minus-control delta > 800.

VERIFIED in real Ruffle (bundled public/ruffle, Vite :1420): pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e filter-pixel-oracle => 3 passed (17.9s) on current fixed main.

REGRESSION PROOF: temporarily stripped filters before publish inside renderDocInRuffle (emulating the 1238 HasFilterList-wrong-bit drop). All 3 FAILED with filtered outside-box count collapsing to exactly 0 == control (blur Received: 0, Expected > 1000). Restored clean; re-ran => 3 passed. Proof the old non-blank oracles (nonWhitePixels>100 / 20% editor diff) could not provide.

Scope: apps/desktop/e2e only; no product code. Units: @flash/swf 1443/1443; @flash/core 5295/5297 (only pre-existing flash8-empty.fla fixture-missing failures, unrelated). CI-skipped like visual-oracle.spec.ts.
